_fixture.label: SYNTHETIC
_fixture.note: Written by hand. No real capture exists yet: no workspace, person or GPT here is real, and every id is made up.
uncertain_fields: OpenAI's Compliance API reference sits behind an enterprise sign-in and could not be read (2026-11-01). OpenAI's public pages say only that it covers workspace GPT configuration and metadata.
The path GET /v1/compliance/workspaces/{workspace_id}/gpts and the host api.chatgpt.com are recalled from third-party connector documents, not confirmed.
The list shape (data, has_more, last_id, cursor paging by after) is assumed from OpenAI's other list endpoints.
owner_id and created_at appear in a third party's summary; their exact spelling and created_at's type (number or string) are assumed. Both types are accepted.
sharing.visibility is assumed. A third party lists Shared Recipients, which this parser does not keep.
latest_config.data[0].name, .tools and the tool members type and domain are assumed. A tools shape that does not match is reported as not scanned and the GPT is marked tools_incomplete.
The recording wrapper (workspace_id, gpts) is PantherClaw's own.
